summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions filed a 6-K disclosing a standstill agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC, entered on May 1, 2026. The agreement rescinds a purchase notice related to a pre-paid purchase under a June 2025 securities purchase agreement for up to $10 million, with an initial principal of $3,165,000. The investor temporarily refrains from delivering purchase notices through May 31, 2026, waives remedies for a delivery default, and retains 635,000 Pre-Delivery Shares permanently. Outstanding balance is $3,209,101; if unpaid by May 31, interest accrues. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for repayment or continued dilutive financing.
